step-2024-p3-q1.summary: For $N\ge1$ let $S_N=\sum_{r=1}^N r^{-2}$ and assume $S_N\to\pi^2/6$. Verify $1/(r+1)-1/r+1/r^2=1/[r^2(r+1)]$. Sum to obtain $\sum_{r=1}^N1/[r^2(r+1)]=S_N-1+1/(N+1)$ and evaluate the corresponding infinite series. Express $\sum_{r=1}^N1/[r^2(r+1)(r+2)]$ in terms of $N,S_N$, and find its infinite limit. Finally prove $\sum_{r\ge1}1/[r^2(r+1)^2]=2\sum_{r\ge1}1/[r^2(r+1)]-1$.
step-2024-p3-q1.answer: The first infinite sum is $\pi^2/6-1$. The second partial sum is $S_N/2-5/8+3/[4(N+1)]-1/[4(N+2)]$, with limit $\pi^2/12-5/8$. The final series sums to $\pi^2/3-3$.

step-2024-p3-q2.summary: Put $R(x)=\sqrt{4x^2-8x+64}$. Solve $R(x)\le|x+8|$ and $R(x)\le|3x-8|$ separately. Show $R(x)-2(x-1)\to0$ as $x\to+\infty$ and draw $R$ alongside the line $y=2(x-1)$. Choose $m,c$ to make $\sqrt{4x^2-5x+4}\le|mx+c|$ hold exactly on $[3,\infty)$. Then construct $p,q,m,c$ so that $|x^2+px+q|\le mx+c$ holds exactly on $[-5,1]\cup[5,7]$.
step-2024-p3-q2.summaryZh: 设 $R(x)=\sqrt{4x^2-8x+64}$。分别解 $R(x)\le|x+8|$ 和 $R(x)\le|3x-8|$。证明 $x\to+\infty$ 时 $R(x)-2(x-1)\to0$，并在同一坐标系画出 $R$ 与直线 $y=2(x-1)$。选取 $m,c$，使 $\sqrt{4x^2-5x+4}\le|mx+c|$ 的解集恰为 $[3,\infty)$。再构造 $p,q,m,c$，使 $|x^2+px+q|\le mx+c$ 的解集恰为 $[-5,1]\cup[5,7]$。
step-2024-p3-q2.answer: The first two sets are $[0,8]$ and $(-\infty,0]\cup[8,\infty)$. One choice for the half-line is $(m,c)=(2,-1)$. For the two intervals take $(p,q,m,c)=(-4,-15,-2,20)$.
step-2024-p3-q2.answerZh: 前两问解集依次为 $[0,8]$ 和 $(-\infty,0]\cup[8,\infty)$。半直线情形可取 $(m,c)=(2,-1)$；两区间情形取 $(p,q,m,c)=(-4,-15,-2,20)$。

step-2024-p3-q3.summary: On $x>0$, let $g(x)=\ln(1+1/x)-(x+c)/[x(x+1)]$ for $c\ge0$. Prove $g'(x)>0$ everywhere if $c\ge1/2$, and find exactly where $g'(x)<0$ for $0\le c<1/2$. You are given $g(x)\to-\infty$ at $0^+$ when $c>0$. Sketch $g$ separately for $c=3/4$ and $c=1/4$. Study $f(x)=(1+1/x)^{x+c}$: prove it decreases for $c\ge1/2$, has a turning point for $0<c<1/2$, and increases when $c=0$.
step-2024-p3-q3.summaryZh: 在 $x>0$ 上设 $g(x)=\ln(1+1/x)-(x+c)/[x(x+1)]$，其中 $c\ge0$。证明当 $c\ge1/2$ 时处处有 $g'(x)>0$；当 $0\le c<1/2$ 时，求 $g'(x)<0$ 的全部范围。已知 $c>0$ 时 $g(x)\to-\infty$（$x\to0^+$）。分别对 $c=3/4$ 和 $c=1/4$ 作出 $g$ 的图像。再考察 $f(x)=(1+1/x)^{x+c}$，证明 $c\ge1/2$ 时它递减，$0<c<1/2$ 时有极值点，而 $c=0$ 时递增。
step-2024-p3-q3.answer: $g'$ has the sign of $(2c-1)x+c$, so its negative-slope interval is $x>c/(1-2c)$ when $c<1/2$. At $c=3/4$ the graph rises to zero from below. At $c=1/4$ it rises past zero to a maximum at $x=1/2$ and then decreases to zero. Since $f'/f=g$, the intermediate case has one minimum.
step-2024-p3-q3.answerZh: $g'$ 与 $(2c-1)x+c$ 同号，故 $c<1/2$ 时负斜率区间为 $x>c/(1-2c)$。$c=3/4$ 时曲线从下方递增趋于零；$c=1/4$ 时先上升穿过横轴，在 $x=1/2$ 达到极大值后下降趋于零。由 $f'/f=g$，中间参数情形恰有一个极小点。

step-2024-p3-q4.summary: For two lines of finite slopes $m_1,m_2$ making a $45^\circ$ acute angle, prove $(m_1-m_2)/(1+m_1m_2)=\pm1$. Fix a nonzero real $a$. On $x^2=4ay$ take tangents at distinct horizontal coordinates $p,q$. Show their intersection has horizontal coordinate $(p+q)/2$ and find its vertical coordinate. Prove every intersection of tangents inclined at $45^\circ$ satisfies $(y+3a)^2=8a^2+x^2$. If instead two tangents meet on $(y+7a)^2=48a^2+3x^2$, prove their acute angle is independent of the intersection and determine it.
step-2024-p3-q4.summaryZh: 两条斜率有限的直线斜率为 $m_1,m_2$，若其锐夹角为 $45^\circ$，证明 $(m_1-m_2)/(1+m_1m_2)=\pm1$。固定非零实数 $a$，在抛物线 $x^2=4ay$ 上横坐标分别为 $p,q$ 的不同点作切线。证明交点横坐标为 $(p+q)/2$，并求纵坐标。证明夹角为 $45^\circ$ 的两切线的交点满足 $(y+3a)^2=8a^2+x^2$。若两切线交于 $(y+7a)^2=48a^2+3x^2$，证明锐夹角为定值并求其值。
step-2024-p3-q4.answer: The tangent intersection is $((p+q)/2,pq/(4a))$. Its squared angle tangent is $(x^2-4ay)/(y+a)^2$. On the last locus this ratio is $1/3$, giving $30^\circ$.
step-2024-p3-q4.answerZh: 切线交点为 $((p+q)/2,pq/(4a))$。夹角的正切平方为 $(x^2-4ay)/(y+a)^2$，代入最后的轨迹得 $1/3$，故锐夹角为 $30^\circ$。

step-2024-p3-q5.summary: For $2\times2$ matrices write $\operatorname{tr}$ for the diagonal sum. Prove $\operatorname{tr}(MN)=\operatorname{tr}(NM)$ and give the sum rule for $\operatorname{tr}(M+N)$. Let $M'$ denote entrywise differentiation in $t$. For invertible $M$ establish $(\det M)'/\det M=\operatorname{tr}(M^{-1}M')$. When $M'=MN-NM$, with $N$ also depending on $t$, show $\det M$, $\operatorname{tr}M$ and $\operatorname{tr}(M^2)$ are constant. Solve this equation with $N=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}t&t\\0&t\end{smallmatrix}\right)$ and $M(0)=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}A&B\\C&D\end{smallmatrix}\right)$. Finally, if invertible matrices obey $M'=MN$ and $\operatorname{tr}M$ is a nonzero constant, must $\operatorname{tr}N$ vanish? Justify your answer.
step-2024-p3-q5.summaryZh: 对 $2\times2$ 矩阵，用 $\operatorname{tr}$ 表示对角线元素之和。证明 $\operatorname{tr}(MN)=\operatorname{tr}(NM)$，并写出 $\operatorname{tr}(M+N)$ 的加法公式。设 $M'$ 表示对每个矩阵元素按 $t$ 求导。当 $M$ 可逆时证明 $(\det M)'/\det M=\operatorname{tr}(M^{-1}M')$。若 $M'=MN-NM$，其中 $N$ 也依赖 $t$，证明 $\det M$、$\operatorname{tr}M$ 和 $\operatorname{tr}(M^2)$ 都为常数。当 $N=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}t&t\\0&t\end{smallmatrix}\right)$ 且 $M(0)=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}A&B\\C&D\end{smallmatrix}\right)$ 时求 $M(t)$。最后，若可逆矩阵满足 $M'=MN$，且 $\operatorname{tr}M$ 为非零常数，是否必有 $\operatorname{tr}N=0$？说明理由。
step-2024-p3-q5.answer: Writing $s=t^2/2$, the solution has rows $(A-Cs,\ B+(A-D)s-Cs^2)$ and $(C,\ D+Cs)$. The last implication is false. Take $M$ with rows $(1,t),(-t,1)$ and $N=M^{-1}M'$. Then $\operatorname{tr}M=2$ but $\operatorname{tr}N=2t/(1+t^2)$.
step-2024-p3-q5.answerZh: 令 $s=t^2/2$，则解的两行为 $(A-Cs,\ B+(A-D)s-Cs^2)$ 与 $(C,\ D+Cs)$。末问的结论不成立。取 $M$ 的两行为 $(1,t),(-t,1)$，并令 $N=M^{-1}M'$，则 $\operatorname{tr}M=2$，而 $\operatorname{tr}N=2t/(1+t^2)$。

step-2024-p3-q6.summary: The control $u(t)$ enters both equations $x'=-x+3y+u$, $y'=x+y+u$. At $t=0$ the position is $(x_0,y_0)$. Analyse $(x-y)'$ to prove that reaching the origin at positive time requires $x_0=y_0$. Under this condition find a constant $u$ giving arrival at a prescribed $T>0$. Repeat in three dimensions with $x'=4y-5z+u$, $y'=x-2z+u$, $z'=x-2y+u$ and initial position $(x_0,y_0,z_0)$. First prove that reaching the origin requires $2y_0=x_0+z_0$, then prove all three initial coordinates must agree. For equal initial coordinates determine a constant $u$ achieving arrival at $T$.
step-2024-p3-q6.summaryZh: 控制函数 $u(t)$ 同时出现在 $x'=-x+3y+u$、$y'=x+y+u$ 中，初始位置为 $(x_0,y_0)$。考察 $(x-y)'$，证明能在正时间到达原点必有 $x_0=y_0$。在此条件下，求一个常数 $u$ 使质点在指定的 $T>0$ 到达原点。再考虑三维方程 $x'=4y-5z+u$、$y'=x-2z+u$、$z'=x-2y+u$，初始位置为 $(x_0,y_0,z_0)$。先证明到达原点必须满足 $2y_0=x_0+z_0$，再证明三个初始坐标必须相等。若三者相等，求能在 $T$ 到达原点的常数 $u$。
step-2024-p3-q6.answer: On the diagonal the plane system becomes $x'=2x+u$, giving $u=-2x_0/(1-e^{-2T})$. The spatial system there becomes $x'=-x+u$, giving $u=-x_0/(e^T-1)$.
step-2024-p3-q6.answerZh: 在对角线上，平面系统化为 $x'=2x+u$，故 $u=-2x_0/(1-e^{-2T})$。三维系统化为 $x'=-x+u$，故 $u=-x_0/(e^T-1)$。

step-2024-p3-q7.summary: For integers $n,j\ge1$ put $a_j=n!/(n+j)!$, $f(n)=\sum_{j\ge1}a_j$ and $g(n)=\sum_{j\ge1}(-1)^{j-1}a_j$. Assume convergence. Compare with a geometric series to prove $0<f(n)<1/n$ and compare adjacent terms to prove $0<g(n)<1/(n+1)$. Using the exponential series prove both $(2n)!e-f(2n)$ and $(2n)!/e+g(2n)$ are integers. If positive integers $p,q$ satisfied $qe=p/e$, prove $qf(2n)+pg(2n)$ would be an integer for every $n$. Deduce the irrationality of $e^2$.
step-2024-p3-q7.summaryZh: 对整数 $n,j\ge1$ 记 $a_j=n!/(n+j)!$、$f(n)=\sum_{j\ge1}a_j$、$g(n)=\sum_{j\ge1}(-1)^{j-1}a_j$，可假设收敛。与等比级数比较，证明 $0<f(n)<1/n$；比较相邻项，证明 $0<g(n)<1/(n+1)$。用指数级数证明 $(2n)!e-f(2n)$ 及 $(2n)!/e+g(2n)$ 均为整数。若存在正整数 $p,q$ 满足 $qe=p/e$，证明对一切 $n$，$qf(2n)+pg(2n)$ 也为整数。由此推出 $e^2$ 无理。
step-2024-p3-q7.answer: The two factorial-scaled expressions are the finite series through degree $2n$ for $e$ and $e^{-1}$, multiplied by $(2n)!$. Under the rationality assumption their integer combination would satisfy $0<qf(2n)+pg(2n)<q/(2n)+p/(2n+1)<1$ for sufficiently large $n$.
step-2024-p3-q7.answerZh: 两项乘阶乘的表达式分别等于 $e$ 与 $e^{-1}$ 的级数截到 $2n$ 次后乘以 $(2n)!$。若假定 $e^2$ 有理，整数 $qf(2n)+pg(2n)$ 在 $n$ 充分大时满足 $0<qf(2n)+pg(2n)<q/(2n)+p/(2n+1)<1$，产生矛盾。

step-2024-p3-q8.summary: Describe the two lines whose union is $(y-x+3)(y+x-5)=0$. Prove that $y^2-x^2+py+qx+r=0$ splits into two lines of slopes $1,-1$ exactly when $p^2-q^2=4r$. Consider $C_1:x=y^2+2sy+s(s+1)$ and $C_2:y=x^2$. Explain why every common point satisfies $y^2+2sy+s(s+1)-x+k(y-x^2)=0$ for every real $k$. Show that $k=1$ places all common points on a pair of lines of slopes $\pm1$. Prove in both directions that the curves have four distinct intersections exactly when $s<-3/4$.
step-2024-p3-q8.summaryZh: 指出 $(y-x+3)(y+x-5)=0$ 表示的两条直线。证明 $y^2-x^2+py+qx+r=0$ 能分解为斜率 $1,-1$ 的两条直线，当且仅当 $p^2-q^2=4r$。现取 $C_1:x=y^2+2sy+s(s+1)$、$C_2:y=x^2$。说明任意公共点对一切实数 $k$ 均满足 $y^2+2sy+s(s+1)-x+k(y-x^2)=0$。证明取 $k=1$ 可将所有交点定位在斜率 $\pm1$ 的一对直线上。分别证明两方向，得出恰有四个不同交点当且仅当 $s<-3/4$。
step-2024-p3-q8.answer: The initial lines are $y=x-3$ and $y=5-x$. For the two parabolas the lines are $y=x-s$ and $y=-x-s-1$. Substitution into $y=x^2$ gives discriminants $1-4s$ and $-3-4s$. For $s<-3/4$ both are positive, and a common root of the two quadratics could occur only at $x=-1/2$, $s=-3/4$.
step-2024-p3-q8.answerZh: 最初的直线为 $y=x-3$、$y=5-x$。两抛物线交点所在直线为 $y=x-s$、$y=-x-s-1$。代入 $y=x^2$ 得两个二次方程，判别式为 $1-4s$ 和 $-3-4s$。当 $s<-3/4$ 时两式均为正；两方程有公共根只可能发生在 $x=-1/2$、$s=-3/4$。

step-2024-p3-q9.summary: Use coordinates of the lowest points of smooth spheres on a smooth horizontal table. Sphere $A$ is at rest at $(0,0)$ and an identical sphere $B$ approaches with velocity $(-u,0)$ along $y=2r\sin\alpha$, from large positive $x$. Both have mass $m$ and radius $r$, $0<\alpha<\pi/2$, and the collision has restitution $1/3$. Derive the velocity of $B$ after impact. If it then crosses the $y$-axis at $(0,Y)$, show $Y=2r(\cos\alpha\tan\beta+\sin\alpha)$, where $\beta$ is the acute angle its path makes with the negative horizontal direction and $\tan\beta=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha/(1+2\sin^2\alpha)$. Another sphere of radius $r$ is at rest at $(0,h)$ with $h>0$. Show that $h>Y+2r\sec\beta$ rules out a subsequent collision of $B$ with this sphere. Prove $Y<2r\sec\beta$ and hence give $h>8r/\sqrt3$ as a sufficient bound for all $\alpha$.
step-2024-p3-q9.summaryZh: 用光滑水平桌面上光滑球的最低点来表示位置。球 $A$ 静止于 $(0,0)$，相同的球 $B$ 从很大的正横坐标处沿 $y=2r\sin\alpha$ 以速度 $(-u,0)$ 接近。两球质量为 $m$、半径为 $r$，$0<\alpha<\pi/2$，恢复系数为 $1/3$。求碰撞后 $B$ 的速度。设此后它穿过纵轴于 $(0,Y)$，其轨迹与水平向左方向的锐夹角为 $\beta$。证明 $Y=2r(\cos\alpha\tan\beta+\sin\alpha)$ 及 $\tan\beta=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha/(1+2\sin^2\alpha)$。另一半径 $r$ 的球静止于 $(0,h)$，$h>0$。证明若 $h>Y+2r\sec\beta$，碰后 $B$ 不会撞到该球。再证 $Y<2r\sec\beta$，进而说明 $h>8r/\sqrt3$ 对所有 $\alpha$ 都足以避免相撞。
step-2024-p3-q9.answer: The velocity is $\big(-u(1+2\sin^2\alpha)/3,\ 2u\sin\alpha\cos\alpha/3\big)$. The distance of $(0,h)$ from the path line is $(h-Y)\cos\beta$ when $h>Y$. Since $\tan\beta\le1/\sqrt3$ and $Y<2r\sec\beta$, the claimed uniform bound suffices.
step-2024-p3-q9.answerZh: 速度为 $\big(-u(1+2\sin^2\alpha)/3,\ 2u\sin\alpha\cos\alpha/3\big)$。当 $h>Y$ 时，$(0,h)$ 到轨迹直线的距离为 $(h-Y)\cos\beta$。因为 $\tan\beta\le1/\sqrt3$ 且 $Y<2r\sec\beta$，所给统一上界足以避免碰撞。

step-2024-p3-q10.summary: Stack centred, edge-aligned uniform cubes of density $\rho$ on a horizontal floor; their side lengths are $1$ below and $0<a\le1$ above. Both contacts have friction coefficient $\mu<1$. Push horizontally and normally on an upper vertical face, midway across it and height $h$ above its bottom, $0<h<a$. Call the force $P$ and the base centres of the upper and lower cubes $X,Y$. In equilibrium show the floor reaction’s normal component acts a distance $P(1+h)/[(1+a^3)\rho g]$ from $Y$, and find the analogous distance from $X$ for the inter-cube reaction. Increase $P$ from zero. Show that if tipping is excluded the upper contact slips first. For $a=1$ show that $\mu(1+h)<1$ gives upper slipping first and $\mu(1+h)>1$ gives tipping of the whole stack first. For $a<1$, assuming no slip, show that $h[1+a^3(1-a)]>a^4$ makes the upper cube tip first. Give feasible $h,\mu$ with $a=1/2$ for this last event.
step-2024-p3-q10.summaryZh: 将两个密度为 $\rho$ 的均质立方体叠放于水平地面，中心上下对齐且对应棱平行。下方边长为 $1$，上方边长为 $0<a\le1$，两接触面的摩擦系数均为 $\mu<1$。在上方立方体某竖直面的横向中央、离其底边 $h$ 处施加垂直于该面的水平推力 $P$，$0<h<a$。设上下立方体底面中心分别为 $X,Y$。平衡时证明地面法向支持力的作用点距 $Y$ 为 $P(1+h)/[(1+a^3)\rho g]$，并求两立方体间法向支持力的作用点到 $X$ 的距离。令 $P$ 从零增大。证明若不倾覆，则先在两立方体之间滑动。当 $a=1$ 时，证明 $\mu(1+h)<1$ 时上块先滑动，而 $\mu(1+h)>1$ 时两块作为整体先倾覆。当 $a<1$ 且无滑动时，证明 $h[1+a^3(1-a)]>a^4$ 足以使上块先倾覆。取 $a=1/2$，给出能实现最后情形的一组 $h,\mu$。
step-2024-p3-q10.answer: The upper reaction offset is $Ph/(a^3\rho g)$. In units of $\rho g$, the upper-slip, upper-tip and whole-stack-tip thresholds are $\mu a^3$, $a^4/(2h)$ and $(1+a^3)/[2(1+h)]$. At $a=1/2$, choose $h=2/5$, $\mu=3/4$; the upper-tip threshold is then the smallest.
step-2024-p3-q10.answerZh: 上块支持力的偏移距离为 $Ph/(a^3\rho g)$。以 $\rho g$ 为单位，上块滑动、上块倾覆、整体倾覆的临界推力分别为 $\mu a^3$、$a^4/(2h)$、$(1+a^3)/[2(1+h)]$。在 $a=1/2$ 时可取 $h=2/5$、$\mu=3/4$，此时上块倾覆的临界力最小。

step-2024-p3-q11.summary: Let $n$ be a positive integer and write $b_r=\binom{2n}{r}$. Prove $rb_r=(2n+1-r)b_{2n+1-r}$ for $1\le r\le2n$ and hence $\sum_{r=0}^{2n}rb_r=2\sum_{r=n+1}^{2n}rb_r$. You may use $\sum_r\binom mr=2^m$ and $\sum_r r\binom mr=m2^{m-1}$. A fair coin is tossed $2n$ times. Let $X$ equal the larger count of heads and tails, taking value $n$ in a tie. Show $E[X]=n(1+2^{-2n}b_n)$ and that $2^{-2n}b_n$ strictly decreases with $n$. A game costs £$n$ to play and pays £$X$. Select $n$ to maximise the expected winnings per pound spent.
step-2024-p3-q11.summaryZh: 令 $n$ 为正整数，记 $b_r=\binom{2n}{r}$。对 $1\le r\le2n$ 证明 $rb_r=(2n+1-r)b_{2n+1-r}$，并导出 $\sum_{r=0}^{2n}rb_r=2\sum_{r=n+1}^{2n}rb_r$。可使用 $\sum_r\binom mr=2^m$、$\sum_r r\binom mr=m2^{m-1}$。抛一枚公平硬币 $2n$ 次，设正反面次数中较大值为 $X$，平手时取 $X=n$。证明 $E[X]=n(1+2^{-2n}b_n)$，并证明 $2^{-2n}b_n$ 随 $n$ 严格递减。若游戏入场费为 $n$ 英镑，奖金为 $X$ 英镑，选择 $n$ 使每支付一英镑的期望所得最大。
step-2024-p3-q11.answer: Put $c_n=4^{-n}\binom{2n}{n}$. The ratio $c_{n+1}/c_n=(2n+1)/(2n+2)<1$. Thus $n=1$ maximises the expected gross return $1+c_n$, at £1.50 per £1 staked (net £0.50).
step-2024-p3-q11.answerZh: 设 $c_n=4^{-n}\binom{2n}{n}$，则 $c_{n+1}/c_n=(2n+1)/(2n+2)<1$。故选 $n=1$，每支付 1 英镑时的期望奖金 $1+c_n$ 最高，为 1.50 英镑（净收益 0.50 英镑）。

step-2024-p3-q12.summary: Select $(x,y)$ uniformly in the unit square $[0,1]^2$, and let $R$ be its distance from $(0,0)$. Derive the distribution function on $0\le r\le1$. For $1\le r\le\sqrt2$, prove $P(R\le r)=\sqrt{r^2-1}+\pi r^2/4-r^2\arccos(1/r)$. Show $E[R]=\tfrac23\int_1^{\sqrt2}r^2/\sqrt{r^2-1}\,dr$ and obtain its exact value.
step-2024-p3-q12.summaryZh: 在单位正方形 $[0,1]^2$ 内均匀选取点 $(x,y)$，记它到 $(0,0)$ 的距离为 $R$。求 $0\le r\le1$ 时的分布函数，并在 $1\le r\le\sqrt2$ 时证明 $P(R\le r)=\sqrt{r^2-1}+\pi r^2/4-r^2\arccos(1/r)$。证明 $E[R]=\tfrac23\int_1^{\sqrt2}r^2/\sqrt{r^2-1}\,dr$，并求出精确值。
step-2024-p3-q12.answer: For $0\le r\le1$ the distribution function is $\pi r^2/4$. The mean distance is $[\sqrt2+\ln(1+\sqrt2)]/3$.
step-2024-p3-q12.answerZh: 当 $0\le r\le1$ 时分布函数为 $\pi r^2/4$。平均距离为 $[\sqrt2+\ln(1+\sqrt2)]/3$。
